desktop-recovery-status.title: Recover original execution results
desktop-recovery-status.state.unprepared: Check the original receipts for locally saved results.
desktop-recovery-status.state.prepared: This batch is prepared. Explicitly check its original result receipts.
desktop-recovery-status.state.checking: Checking the original result receipts for this batch. Await this request's outcome.
desktop-recovery-status.state.unknown: This batch's outcome is unconfirmed. Check the same recovery request and keep its operation record.
desktop-recovery-status.state.complete: Original receipts for this batch have been checked. Read connection status to check renewal eligibility; the original tasks and side effects still need separate verification.
desktop-recovery-status.state.partial: Only some original receipts in this batch have been checked. Other entries are retained; follow the reason before continuing.
desktop-recovery-status.state.blocked: Original receipts in this batch cannot currently be checked. Address the current reason and retain the original local records.
desktop-recovery-status.boundary: This checks original receipts for this batch only. Other unsettled work, new connections, renewal, task acceptance and deployment are handled separately.
desktop-recovery-status.reason.no_saved_: No saved results eligible for this check were found. Read connection status to check the original node's next step.
desktop-recovery-status.reason.receipt_m: A matching original result receipt was not found. Retain local records and check the original submission.
The original receipt differs from the local result evidence. Retain the records and check the original source.
desktop-recovery-status.reason.unsupport: Some unsettled work is outside this entry's scope. Use its corresponding original-execution verification flow.
desktop-recovery-status.reason.state_cha: The original local record changed. Keep the record and read the current status again.
desktop-recovery-status.reason.source_ch: The current project, workspace or original execution source changed. Check the original source before continuing recovery.
desktop-recovery-status.reason.access_ch: Current access changed. After access is restored, check the original recovery request.
desktop-recovery-status.reason.invalid_s: The original recovery record could not be verified. Keep the record and check the local status.
desktop-recovery-status.reason.active_wo: The original execution process has not been confirmed closed. Explicitly stop it and verify closure first.
desktop-recovery-status.reason.result_un: The original result still has unknown effects. Its outcome needs separate verification even after receipt acknowledgement is restored.
desktop-recovery-status.reason.proof_exp: The short-lived verification proof expired. Under current authorization, check the same recovery request again.
